title: What makes a supplier download useful to a buyer
body:
Try the fictional supplier register and review the generated downloads list. Which labels help a buyer decide whether a document is relevant? Suggestions about versions, ownership and review reminders are welcome. Please use synthetic records rather than private supplier documents. [Aberdeen Web Design](https://webdesignaberdeen.uk/) maintains this resource through JW Digital Services Ltd.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Web-Design-Aberdeen/supplier-document-register#readme), then run the documented example locally.
